name: L99 Story Engine
mission: Provide a provenance-safe AI runtime and story operations layer with tenant isolation, revocation, recovery, observable promotion gates, and controlled publishing boundaries.

capabilities.notes: Executable Python and Node components exist, but implementation presence receives no readiness credit without exact-head proof.
Promotion-gate and security tests exist; exact-head passing evidence must be attached before partial or verified status.
Exact-head promotion gates are defined, but no passing run is attached.
No immutable deployment artifact is attached.
Code-revert concepts and operational events exist, but no executed rollback proof is attached.
Operational events and dashboards exist, but production runtime health is not proven.
Production readiness is blocked by hardened session design and complete workspace authorization proof.
Partitioning and isolation contracts exist; live persistence behavior is not proven.
Runtime services and handlers exist; supported API behavior is not proven.
AI runtime and provider contracts exist; live model behavior is not proven.
No MCP execution proof is attached.
Automation implementation exists, but end-to-end production execution is not proven.
Latency and telemetry analyzers exist; current execution evidence is not attached.
Event bus, correlation IDs, dashboards, and latency monitors exist without current runtime proof.
Known blockers include Stripe signature verification, browser-readable key persistence, CSP hardening, and authorization coverage.
Artifact writers and event contracts exist; immutable exact-head evidence binding is not yet attached.

verification.purpose: Validate canonical capabilities, proof structure, exact-head binding, blocker contradictions, and rollback scope.
Verify the existing Founder Control Room federation contract.
Run provenance, revocation, partition, event, drift, shell, and latency gates.
Verify header authentication and cookie rejection behavior.

rollback.method: Revert the exact promoted commit and replay revocation and operational events through the append-only event spine. This covers code rollback only; external side effects, data mutations, infrastructure, secrets, and provider state require separate proof.

blockers: Cryptographic Stripe webhook verification is not proven.
Browser-readable API-key persistence requires hardened authentication and session design.
Browser Content Security Policy requires tightening.
Workspace authorization must be proven on every read and mutation path.
Exact-head CI evidence has not yet been attached to this contract.
next_gate: Pass exact-head validation, publish immutable workflow evidence with repository, commit, scope, and timestamp binding, and let Founder Control Room independently authenticate it before promoting any capability.
